name: skeleton
useFor: Use in the shape of what will load: table rows with their site image and tags, cited fields, a card's values. Match each part's size; everything is square. It waits before it appears, so a quick load never flashes it.
constraints: Skeletons for content already on screen
A skeleton for a single button
source: Built from the palette: Fog and Mist, Figma's hover and pressed fills (442:2)
title: Skeleton
description: A square Fog block in the shape of what will load, breathing toward Mist; it shows only after 450ms.
